item.title: Brittany Norwood Used Size-14 Shoes To Stage A Robbery
item.description: Jayna Murray was killed at a Maryland Lululemon store in 2011. Her coworker Brittany Norwood planted footprints with men’s shoes and falsely claimed masked intruders had attacked them. Norwood was convicted of first-degree murder and sentenced to life without parole in 2012.

item.title: Cortney Bell’s Murder Conviction Was Overturned On Appeal
item.description: Christopher McNabb received life without parole for the 2017 murder of his infant daughter, Caliyah, in Georgia. Appeals courts overturned all three convictions against her mother, Cortney Bell, in 2022 and 2023, finding insufficient evidence.

item.title: Barbora Škrlová Posed As A 13-Year-Old Boy At 33
item.description: Barbora Škrlová posed as a girl in the Mauerová household before fleeing to Norway and attending school as a boy. In 2008, she received a five-year sentence for her role in abusing two Czech brothers. She was released on parole in 2012.

item.title: Chris Coleman’s Fake Threats Came From His Own Laptop
item.description: Chris Coleman, security chief for Joyce Meyer Ministries, claimed his family was being threatened. After his wife Sheri and their two sons were killed in Illinois in 2009, investigators traced the emails to his laptop. He was convicted in 2011 and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Lyndon McLeod Named Future Victims In His Novels
item.description: Lyndon McLeod killed five people in Denver and Lakewood in December 2021. His novels, which named two victims in fictional killings, became part of the investigation. The attacks ended when a wounded police officer shot and killed him.

item.title: Over 20 Missed Chances To Stop Beastie House Abuse
item.description: Three children were abused in Glasgow’s “Beastie House” between 2012 and 2019. Seven offenders received prison sentences with lifelong restrictions in 2025. A 2026 review identified more than 20 missed opportunities for agencies to intervene and protect the children.

item.title: She Tried To Kill Him. Then She Cross-Examined Him
item.description: Sheila Davalloo’s husband survived her 2003 attack. Nine years later, she represented herself and questioned him at her trial for murdering romantic rival Anna Lisa Raymundo. Her convictions brought consecutive prison sentences totaling 75 years.

item.title: He Taunted The CCTV Camera That Caught His Murder
item.description: Stephen Griffiths gestured at a CCTV camera after killing Suzanne Blamires in Bradford. A caretaker reviewing the footage alerted police. In December 2010, the criminology student pleaded guilty to murdering three women and received whole-life sentences.
